levels.surface: جعفر بن عبد الله بن الحكم

notes: «واللفظ لعبد» is a wording note and is left out; the three co-transmitters meet at يعقوب.
The remark «قال صالح وقد تحدث بنحو ذلك عن أبي رافع» names a different route for a similar saying, so it is a variant group, never a route (rule 4).
The story after the matn (Abu Rafi' tells Ibn Umar, then Ibn Mas'ud confirms) is narration about the report, not a second isnad; Ibn Mas'ud is already the last link.
